subject: DPIA evidence: minimal kit & subprocessor scope confirmation
messages:
From: Angela Meyers <angela.meyers@northbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Holden <tom.holden@northbridge.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: minimal DPIA evidence kit + confirmation of subprocessor scope

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the call earlier — NorthBridge needs a concise evidence package so our Data Protection & Risk team can clear the DPIA gate for the pilot. To keep the review tight, can you provide a "minimal evidence kit" that covers the following items?

- Article 30 processing ledger excerpt for the services and sample records (CSV)
- Subprocessor inventory snapshot showing the specific subprocessor handling PHI-like metadata and their region
- KMS attestation (how keys are stored/managed; responsible parties)
- Confirmation of contractually scoped audit rights (Art. 28/30) and access process for an on-site or remote audit

Can you also confirm whether any current subprocessor change (planned migrations) would affect residency or require SCCs/transfer mechanisms? We aim to complete review within 5 business days of receiving the kit.

Attachments: none

Appreciate a short timeline and who on your side will coordinate.

Best,
Angela
Angela Meyers
Sr. InfoSec Risk Manager — NorthBridge Health
angela.meyers@northbridge.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Angela Meyers <angela.meyers@northbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: minimal DPIA evidence kit + confirmation of subprocessor scope

Hi Angela — thanks, and yes we can provide a compact kit. I'll coordinate delivery.

Planned contents (minimal set):
1) Article 30 ledger excerpt (CSV with processing activity, legal basis, category of data, storage location)
2) Subprocessor inventory snapshot (filter: processors that touch message metadata or tokenized content)
3) KMS attestation (PDF signed by ops) + key rotation cadence and key custody notes
4) Audit rights summary (DPA excerpt indicating scope, notice period, redaction process)
5) Short runbook describing remote evidence access and sample ledger query used to generate the excerpt

I'm asking Marissa to pull the ledger sample and the subprocessor snapshot. Marcus will prepare the KMS attestation. Karthik, can you confirm if any planned subprocessor migrations in Q2/Q3 will impact residency or require additional transfer mechanisms?

Target turnaround: 48 hours for the initial package (article 30 CSV + inventory snapshot + draft KMS attestation). If NorthBridge needs a signed attestation or DocuSign path, Ben (copied on follow-up) will coordinate procurement steps.

I'll include a Drive folder link with the artifacts and a short readme. If that works, we'll send the kit and schedule a 30-min walk-through afterward.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Privacy Operations — Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: minimal DPIA evidence kit + confirmation of subprocessor scope

Irene — working on it. Quick status and notes: 

- Article 30 ledger excerpt: I can produce a CSV extract scoped to the "inference-api" product for the last 12 months. Attached sample filename: article30-ledger-sample.csv (contains field headers and 10 sample rows; PII redacted).
- Subprocessor inventory snapshot: produced a filtered JSON export showing processor name, function, location, and declared legal basis category. Filename: subprocessor-inventory-snapshot.json. The snapshot highlights one subprocessor (EdgeCache Systems) that routes caching to eu-central-1 for latency reasons — not PHI processing but handles metadata; documented in the snapshot.
- Evidence packaging: I'll add a short readme.txt with the query and parameters used to generate the ledger excerpt.

Open question for Karthik: EdgeCache Systems has a planned firmware rollout in Q3; any transfer mechanism or SCC changes expected? If not, we'll note it as a planned maintenance item with no immediate transfer impact.

I'm uploading the sample CSV & snapshot to the Drive folder and will attach the final artifacts to the kit.

Attachments: article30-ledger-sample.csv, subprocessor-inventory-snapshot.json

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Privacy Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: minimal DPIA evidence kit + confirmation of subprocessor scope

Marissa/Irene — draft KMS attestation attached. Key points in the attestation:

- Keys stored in customer-dedicated KMS tenant; HSM-backed with split custody controls
- Rotation cadence: 90 days for data keys, 365 days for master wrapping key
- Access: ops only via JIT with MFA; audit logs retained for 24 months
- Export: we provide an attestation PDF; we cannot share raw private key material

I've included the key identifier and a redacted JWK thumbprint in the attestation. Attachment: kms-attestation.pdf

Ben — can you confirm whether NorthBridge needs a signed attestation (DocuSign) vs. a company-letterhead PDF? Also, procurement may want the DPA clause reference for audit rights. The relevant DPA excerpt is typically Section 7 (Audit & Inspection) in our DPA addendum; I can reference the specific paragraph if needed.

Note on subprocessors: we have no forced residency changes planned that would affect transfer mechanisms. Karthik, please flag if that changes.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Security Engineering — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Tom Holden <tom.holden@northbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Angela Meyers <angela.meyers@northbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: minimal DPIA evidence kit + confirmation of subprocessor scope

Team — thanks, this is helpful.

We received the sample CSV, the inventory snapshot, and the draft KMS attestation in the Drive folder. That should be sufficient for an initial DPIA review. Two items:

1) We'd like a short 30-minute remote workshop tomorrow (our risk + privacy) to walk through the ledger extract and the KMS attestation — can you propose two 30-min windows (PST)?
2) Procurement: we need a signed attestation for records. DocuSign is preferred; please send the document to tom.holden@northbridge.com and procurement@northbridge.com.

If the workshop confirms no open technical red flags, we expect to clear the DPIA within 3 business days.

Thanks again — looking forward to the slots.

Tom Holden
Senior Procurement Manager — NorthBridge Health
procurement@northbridge.com
